risks: Zone resolver keys off event.charactersIgnoringModifiers (shared with the tile branch) — a non-US keyboard layout whose digit row yields non-ASCII glyphs wouldn't match the digit ordinals (pre-existing pattern, flagged for awareness).
Release-⌥-no-snap-back not explicitly asserted (structurally impossible — disarmLeader() runs before the persistent setViewport; a later ⌥-release is a no-op on a closed modal). Low.
needsHuman: Jump target = zone-FIT, not last-active-tile (the model has no per-zone lastActiveTile). Confirm zone-fit is desired, or schedule a T01 follow-on for a per-zone lastActiveTileId.

Precedence: a configured zone navKey beats a colliding tile label; auto ordinals skip live tile labels. With disjoint defaults (zones=digits, tiles=letters) collisions never occur; the rule only bites under user rebinding. Confirm vs tile-labels-win (flip branch order + invert assertion 5).
Zone-jump HUD badge NOT drawn (out-of-scope / morning polish) — the leader HUD doesn't show which key jumps which zone. Visual gate before it feels complete to a user.
